name: Progress
import: import { Progress, ProgressTrack, ProgressIndicator, ProgressLabel, ProgressValue } from "@/components/ui/progress"

Progress.name: aria-valuetext
Progress.description: A string value that provides a user-friendly name for `aria-valuenow`, the current value of the progress bar.

Progress.name: getAriaValueText
Progress.description: Accepts a function which returns a string value that provides a human-readable text alternative for the current value of the progress bar.

Progress.name: locale
Progress.description:
The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting the value.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

Progress.name: value
Progress.description: The current value. The component is indeterminate when value is `null`.

Progress.name: className
Progress.description:

returns a class based on the component's state.

Progress.name: render
Progress.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

Progress.name: style
Progress.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.
